reason: I like that it can use my projects and lets me review AI drafts, but I cannot tell how it prevents made-up claims or how much of setup and usage will cost me. Since I can already track applications in a spreadsheet, I would wait for a real demo before installing another tool.
objection: How do I know the AI will stick to the projects and facts I give it, and what will I need to pay for keys or hosting?
would_change_my_mind: A short demo showing a project-based resume draft with no invented details, plus a clear setup and cost estimate.
